task.title: Analytics Dashboard with Charts
task.buildPrompt: Build an analytics dashboard with: a date-range selector (Last 7 days / 30 days / 90 days), a line chart of revenue over the selected range, a bar chart of top 5 products by sales, and 4 KPI cards (Total Revenue, Orders, Avg Order Value, Conversion Rate) that recompute when the date range changes. Use mock/generated data. Include a CSV export button for the currently visible data.

checks.description: Page loads without console errors
4 KPI cards visible (Revenue, Orders, Avg Order Value, Conversion Rate)
checks.expected: All 4 KPI metrics present in text

checks.description: Date-range selector present (7, 30, 90 days options)
Changing date range recomputes KPI values
checks.expected: KPI values change on date range switch

checks.description: Line chart and Bar chart elements rendered
CSV Export button present and clickable
Charts and metrics remain populated after range toggle

task.title: Real-Time Chat UI (Simulated)
task.buildPrompt: Build a chat interface with a conversation list sidebar (5 mock contacts, showing last message preview and unread badge), a message thread view, a message input with send button, and simulated 'typing...' and auto-reply behavior (bot responds 1-2 seconds after user sends a message). Clicking a different contact switches the thread and clears its unread badge.

checks.description: Page loads without console errors
Contact list sidebar visible with contacts
Sending a message adds it to the active thread
checks.error:
locator.fill: Timeout 2000ms exceeded.
Call log:
[2m  - waiting for locator('input[type="text"], textarea, [placeholder*="message"], [placeholder*="Type"]').first()[22m

checks.description: Simulated 'typing...' indicator or bot response indicator appears
Bot auto-reply message arrives within 3.5 seconds
Clicking another contact switches the thread view
checks.expected: Thread content changes on contact selection

checks.description: Unread badges clear or update when contact is selected

task.title: Booking/Reservation Calendar
task.buildPrompt: Build a booking calendar app: month-view calendar, clicking a date opens a time-slot picker (9am-5pm, 1-hour slots), already-booked slots are disabled/greyed, booking a slot requires name + email, and booked slots show up visually on the calendar (e.g. a dot or count badge on that date). Include a 'My Bookings' list view showing all bookings with a cancel option that frees the slot back up.

checks.description: Page loads without console errors
Month-view calendar visible with date grid
checks.actual: Date visible: false, Month text: false

checks.description: Clicking a date displays available time slots
checks.expected: Time slot options visible after clicking date

checks.description: Booking a time slot with Name + Email succeeds
checks.expected: Booking confirmed for Jane Doe Benchmark

checks.description: Booked date shows visual indicator (badge/dot/highlight)
checks.expected: Visual indicator present on booked date

checks.description: 'My Bookings' section displays the newly booked reservation
checks.expected: Booking for Jane Doe Benchmark listed in My Bookings

checks.description: Cancelling booking removes it from list and frees up slot
